frontend/src/components/agent/PropertyFo: Reusable form for creating or editing property data, handling inputs, validation, and image uploads.

frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Layout wrapper that places header, main content, and footer.

Image gallery with main image and thumbnail carousel for property listings.
